Language requirements
English Proficiency Tests
All applicants who have not obtained a previous diploma in a programme taught in English in Australia, English-speaking Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom or the United States of America must submit one of the tests mentioned on this webpage, proving their proficiency in English.
Read More…
Dutch Proficiency Tests
KU Leuven only accepts the certificates mentioned on this page as proof of Dutch proficiency. The minimum required language level of Dutch to study at KU Leuven is a B2-level. For certain programmes, however, a C1-level is required. You can check the minimum required level in the admission requirements of the programme of your interest.
